projects.name: First Contribution Trail
projects.recentActivity: Published a draft setup guide and labeled three starter issues for contributor feedback.
projects.summary: Make the first contribution less intimidating with a guided path from local setup to a small pull request. Try the guide and flag any missing steps.

projects.name: Accessible Component Library
projects.recentActivity: Completed keyboard checks for the navigation menu; dialog reviews are next.
projects.summary: Build reusable interface components that work for keyboard and screen-reader users. Contributors can help test focus behavior and document examples.

projects.summary: Help local communities adapt the getting-started documentation. Volunteer reviewers are needed to check terminology before translations are published.

projects.name: Sandbox Preview Service

projects.name: Issue Template Refresh
projects.recentActivity: Released clearer bug-report and feature-request templates with tested examples.
projects.summary: Help maintainers reproduce problems and understand suggestions with fewer follow-up questions. The templates are ready to use; share feedback from real reports.

projects.name: Maintainer Handoff Notes
projects.recentActivity: Added release and triage checklists; invited maintainers to review ownership details.
projects.summary: Keep recurring maintenance tasks understandable when volunteers rotate. Review a checklist and suggest any project knowledge that should be written down.
